jobs.occupation: Regional Head of Travel, Health, IT & Cyber (THIC)
jobs.description:
Present in more than 190 countries, with 12,000 employees and €5.8 billion in business activity, Redion is the world leader in employee benefits and the second-largest provider of assistance and travel insurance services.

We support millions of people worldwide through simple, seamless and accessible solutions across protection, health, mobility and assistance.

Technology and Artificial Intelligence are at the core of our development, enhancing customer experience while valuing human expertise.

Our values: Care, Collaboration, Agility, Reliability and Expertise guide our actions every day.

Joining Redion means contributing to a fast-growing global platform within an agile and international environment, while making a tangible impact.

Our ambition: to become the world's leading Care partner.
Always ready. Always on.

Jobomschrijving

As a Regional Head of Travel, Health, IT & Cyber, you will directly contribute to ensuring the performance, governance, and continuous improvement of operations across Northern Europe.

Within the Operations department, you will work in a multi-country, transformational and operational environment, driving excellence in service delivery while shaping the future of our Travel, Health, IT & Cyber activities.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Define and execute the regional operational strategy aligned with business objectives
• Drive operational performance by managing KPIs, optimizing processes, and controlling costs
• Ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction across all operations
• Lead and develop multi-country teams, fostering collaboration and accountability
• Manage key stakeholders and governance across Operations, IT, HR, Finance, and Business Lines
• Drive transformation initiatives, including digitalization, automation, and continuous improvement
• Build capabilities and develop talent across the region

• Education: Master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field
• Experience: You have 5  years of experience in operations, including senior leadership roles, ideally within medical assistance, healthcare, or service environments
• Skills: Operational management, process optimization, performance management, transformation and digitalization expertise
• Languages: Fluent in English (C1); additional NE Unit languages are an asset (Dutch, French, German, Italian,)
• Soft skills: Strong leadership, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, stakeholder management, analytical mindset, adaptability and resilience

Founded in 1963, Europ Assistance—the inventor of assistance—has been supporting customers for over sixty years. Today, Generali Employee Benefits is part of that story.

Together, we are Redion: one global care partner supporting people and organizations in more than 190 countries through a trusted network of providers and assistance centres.

Our mission is simple: one name, one purpose, one team.

Redion Northern Europe is a Business Unit covering Austria, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Switzerland.

Working at Redion means being part of a dynamic, international environment where innovation, operational excellence and people development are key drivers of our success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Senior Workforce Manager, you are responsible for leading and further developing Workforce Management across the Northern Europe region. You ensure the right balance between operational performance, customer experience and efficient resource allocation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Leading forecasting, capacity planning and workforce modelling for short-, medium- and long-term business needs
• Translating business objectives into workforce requirements and staffing strategies
• Anticipating workforce risks, operational impacts and capacity constraints, and providing actionable recommendations
• Establishing and continuously improving Workforce Management frameworks, standards and governance
• Optimizing staffing levels, scheduling and workforce allocation to meet service and productivity targets
• Monitoring workforce performance and driving continuous improvement initiatives
• Developing reporting, dashboards and workforce analytics to support decision-making
• Leading, coaching and developing the Workforce Management team
• Acting as a strategic partner to Operations, HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders
• Driving transformation, automation and adoption of Workforce Management best practices

• Strong expertise in Workforce Management
• Excellent forecasting and capacity planning capabilities
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to anticipate risks and translate data into insights
• Strategic thinker with strong operational execution skills
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
• Proactive, solution-oriented and data-driven mindset
• Strong ownership, accountability and decision-making skills
• Proven leadership and coaching capabilities
• Ability to manage complexity in a multi-country environment
Languages

• English (C1)
• French and/or Dutch required
• German is a plusTraining and experience
• Minimum 5 years of experience in Workforce Management
• Proven experience in forecasting, workforce planning, scheduling and capacity management
• Experience in a call center, assistance or customer operations environment is strongly preferred
• Experience in leading and developing teams
• Strong knowledge of Workforce Management methodologies and tools
• Knowledge of Verint is an asset
• Experience in a multi-site and/or international environment is an advantage

After a few years in finance, you know the difference between running the accounting and running the numbers. You have done the closings, the VAT returns, the audit files. What you want now is a role where controlling and business partnering matter as much as the statutory work, and a clear path to Finance Manager within three to five years.
 

That is this role.
 

Our partner is a global law firm with a well-established Brussels office and an integrated global finance organization. The transactional accounting is progressively moving to a shared service centre, which means the Brussels finance seat is evolving toward controlling, tax and business partnering. You report to the Finance Manager and work daily with the Office Managing Partner, the COO and the local business teams.
 

Your impact as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Full ownership of the monthly close for the Belgian entity, including all general ledger work and the fixed asset cycle
  

•  

Controlling, budgeting, forecasting and cost analysis in close partnership with senior management and the local business teams
  

•  

The Belgian tax and statutory backbone, from VAT and Corporate Income Tax to audit files and government submissions
  

•  

Balance sheet integrity and clean reconciliations across the perimeter, in line with the group's controls framework
  

•  

Continuous improvement of finance processes, from reporting tools to the impact of shared services on the local scope
   

You are the Belgian finance anchor of a global firm, on the path to Finance Manager.
 

Your profile as Senior Accountant & Controller
 
 

•  

Bachelor or Master in Finance, Accounting or similar
  

•  

3 to 10 years of experience with controlling and (tax) accounting exposure
  

•  

Fluent in French or Dutch (native level), with full English proficiency
  

•  

Experience with Belgian VAT, Corporate Income Tax and legal finance systems is a strong plus

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

You have no fear of heights.
